correctness.rationale: Hausdorff distance <=2^{-(r+1)} is equivalent to identical centered blocks of length m=2r+1 in both directions. The maximal permitted m-step subshift is Y_m for m<q, while m>=q forces one marker in each q-block and hence exactly P_q. The primitive marker-spacing SFT has characteristic polynomial lambda^m-lambda^{m-1}-1 and determinant det(I-zA)=1-z-z^m, including m=1. Unique full-support MME implies every proper subshift has strictly smaller entropy. Discreteness of metric distances gives isolation 2^{-floor(q/2)}, and the root equation gives last-available H~W(q)/q.
